document: DEVELOPER HANDOFF ADDENDUM B - Ambient paid landing pages
status: NOT DEPLOYED. No website, GTM, WhatConverts, form or DNS change was made.
evidence_basis: Headless Chromium renders of all five live paid pages at desktop 1440x900, mobile 412x915, and desktop with tracking parameters. 15 renders total, all HTTP 202, all 158-173 KB (well above the ~12 KB SG-Captcha stub), all first-attempt successes. Evidence: snapshots/lp-audit-2026-08-21d.json and snapshots/gas-boiler-lp-gate-2026-08-22.json. No form was submitted and no telephone link was clicked.
deployment_authority: NOT AVAILABLE in this environment. No WordPress filesystem, no SFTP, no staging, no GTM API access, no WhatConverts admin. Credentials were not requested. Independent search of the workspace confirms no site source, theme, or deployment configuration exists locally. This addendum is a handoff, not a deployment.

DEFECT_1_gas_boiler_cross_service_headin.observed_h2: Your HVAC Replacement in 3 Simple Steps
DEFECT_1_gas_boiler_cross_service_headin.required_h2: Your Gas Boiler Repair in 3 Simple Steps
DEFECT_1_gas_boiler_cross_service_headin.still_live_at: 2026-08-22 01:30 EDT, desktop and mobile, both confirmed
DEFECT_1_gas_boiler_cross_service_headin.root_cause_hypothesis: The identical heading is CORRECT on /hvac-replacement/. The 3-Simple-Steps Divi block appears to have been duplicated from the HVAC Replacement layout into the Gas Boiler layout without editing the heading. Check Divi library / global modules first, because a global module would mean editing it in one place changes both pages.
DEFECT_1_gas_boiler_cross_service_headin.acceptance: Render both pages; /gas-boiler-repair/ must show the Gas Boiler wording and /hvac-replacement/ must still show the HVAC Replacement wording.

DEFECT_2_hvac_repair_recent_work_heading.severity: P1 - newly found 2026-08-21, not in the original handoff
DEFECT_2_hvac_repair_recent_work_heading.note: Same duplication pattern as DEFECT_1, this time inherited from the AC Repair layout. Every other heading on the HVAC Repair page is correct.
DEFECT_2_hvac_repair_recent_work_heading.acceptance: Render /hvac-repair/; the recent-work heading must say HVAC Repair.

DEFECT_3_phone_race_condition_root_cause.NEW_EVIDENCE: The WhatConverts swap cookie wc_swap is present on ALL FIVE paid pages with the identical value '4109141456+..+4107610932+..+230773'. The middle value is the number WhatConverts is configured to FIND, and the first value is what it SWAPS IN. This is runtime proof that +14107610932 is the configured swap SOURCE for WhatConverts profile 105803 on the paid subdomain.
DEFECT_3_phone_race_condition_root_cause.why_it_appears_intermittently: The swap is performed client-side. Any DOM read that happens before the WhatConverts script finishes sees the pre-swap source number. That is the race condition. It is not a random defect and it is not a constant defect.
DEFECT_3_phone_race_condition_root_cause.recommended_fix: Change the swap SOURCE in WhatConverts profile 105803 from 4107610932 to the approved paid base number 4107056354, and make the page markup carry 4107056354 as its hardcoded base. Then a pre-swap read exposes the approved paid number instead of the main-site number.
DEFECT_3_phone_race_condition_root_cause.DO_NOT: Do not remove WhatConverts. Do not change the DNI replacement number 4109141456, which is intentional and approved. Do not make this change without Green Marketing confirming that 4107610932 is stale rather than deliberately retained.
DEFECT_3_phone_race_condition_root_cause.acceptance: After the change, wc_swap must no longer contain 4107610932 on any of the five paid pages, and the DNI replacement must still be 4109141456.

DEFECT_4_malformed_tel_links.problem: tel:(410) 705-6354 contains parentheses and a space. tel:4107056354 omits the country code. Only the DNI link is well formed. Malformed tel: values are handled inconsistently across mobile dialers.
DEFECT_4_malformed_tel_links.required: All hardcoded tel: hrefs must be E.164, i.e. tel:+14107056354.
DEFECT_4_malformed_tel_links.caution: Normalize the href only. Do not change the VISIBLE text and do not alter the element attributes or classes WhatConverts uses to find and swap numbers, or DNI will break.
DEFECT_4_malformed_tel_links.acceptance: Every tel: href matches ^tel:\+1[0-9]{10}$ and DNI still swaps.

DEFECT_5_three_duplicate_form_instances.observed: Each page renders THREE <form> elements, all with id='gform_1', all with the same action, each with 23 fields. 34 duplicate DOM ids per page, including field_1_1 through field_1_15, input_9 through input_15, state_1, is_submit_1 and et-boc.
DEFECT_5_three_duplicate_form_instances.why_it_matters: Duplicate ids are invalid HTML. label[for] resolves to the first match only, so labels on the second and third instances are not programmatically associated - an accessibility failure. A GTM form-submit trigger keyed on an id or a generic form selector can bind to the wrong instance or fire more than once, which is a plausible contributor to duplicate form conversions.
DEFECT_5_three_duplicate_form_instances.required: Prefer ONE rendered form per page. If the layout genuinely needs the form in three places, every DOM id, label for-attribute, error container id, field id and event binding must be unique per instance.
DEFECT_5_three_duplicate_form_instances.acceptance: document.querySelectorAll('form').length is 1, OR zero duplicate ids exist. Then AT-4 and AT-10 through AT-12 must still pass.

DEFECT_6_no_privacy_or_terms_links.observed: Zero links whose text or href contains privacy or terms, on every page, on desktop and mobile.
DEFECT_6_no_privacy_or_terms_links.required: Add Privacy Policy and Terms links using REAL existing Ambient URLs only. Do not invent legal text and do not invent URLs. If no published policy exists, that is a client decision, not a developer decision.
DEFECT_6_no_privacy_or_terms_links.quality_score_note: HVAC Repair and HVAC Replacement keywords currently report landing-page experience BELOW_AVERAGE. Missing legal links are a recognised trust signal and a plausible contributor, but Google does not expose per-signal attribution. Treat the link as an INFERENCE, not proven causation.
DEFECT_6_no_privacy_or_terms_links.acceptance: Both links present, resolving to real Ambient pages, on all five.
